verdict.rationale: Gusto's own press release states that developers and power users can "install the Gusto CLI in one command" alongside its MCP server. It frames this as letting an agent prepare payroll work and send prioritized decisions for owner approval, so an official CLI exists for AI-native workflows. The evidence is a single press-release mention, though, with no CLI documentation, command reference, or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: first-party CLI documentation (commands, auth, scope of operations), install details, evidence of agent-oriented CLI usage beyond the press claim, independent or hands-on corroboration.
